messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO violation detected for /v1/streaming/generate (prod, us-east-1). p95=320ms p99=2.1s. Auto-pager triggered to on-call.

alina: i'm on-call. picking this up. any initial customer reports or anomalies?

matt: telemetry flagged two tenants with elevated tail latency (cust-b + internal-load-tests). traces show long preproc and streaming stalls aligning with high template render times.

alina: share sample distribution pls.

kyle: here's quick snapshot (11:40-11:46 UTC):
```
p50 130ms
p95 320ms
p99 2.1s
streaming stall (>=250ms) up 7x vs baseline
```

matt: digging into traces — many requests annotated tooling=structured_json and include inlined tool schemas. example log: `template_render=1.22s, tokenize_time=0.35s, total=1.7s` for a 2-field prompt.

hema: interesting. template hydration seems to blow up for some templates. if hydration produces extremely long intermediate strings we pay extra tokenize & copy cost. is our template engine expanding schema references inline?

alina: looks like it does for `tool_schema.tools[*].params[*].items`. some clients submit deeply nested descriptors that explode text size. possible mitigation: stop expanding descriptive labels during render.

kyle: i have a quick patch to bypass verbose label expansion for recognized schema keys and prefer short refs. low-risk. i can ship a canary in ~4m.

devin: we can also add an ingress routing override: requests with header `X-Prefers: json` and streaming=true -> route to fallback-pool (non-streaming path) which has been tuned for heavy-preproc. can deploy rule in ~3m.

ingress-team-bot: plan submitted: routing-override/3599997777 -> start canary on 4 edge nodes. monitoring 5m.

matt: customer comms: cust-b is seeing spikes during batch jobs. notifying them of temporary mitigation.

alina: i prefer a two-pronged approach: 1) route heavy json-mode streaming to fallback non-streaming pool; 2) impose a soft ingress gate that rejects tool-schema-too-deep with 413 + guidance header. this will reduce p99 quickly.

devin: ingress gate doable. propose `tool_schema_depth > 5` -> 413 with header `X-RW-Reason: schema-depth` and body link to best-practices. can roll in ~8-10m.

hema: capture traces and a corpus of offending requests for postmortem. i'll grab top 500 p99 requests and sample payloads.

kyle: canary for template fix is live on 4 nodes. no errors in 3m. promoting to prod canary now.

ingress-team-bot: routing override applied to designated nodes. observing.

matt: quick telemetry after routing: routed requests p99 ~480ms. non-routed heavy requests still high. overall p99 dropped to ~950ms.

alina: proceeding with ingress gate rollout as soft-reject. devin, proceed when ready.

devin: gate rollout started: rule id gate-3599997777 -> 6 edge nodes. returning 413 for ~0.6% of incoming requests (mostly bot traffic).

matt: metrics 11:58UTC: p50 120ms p95 170ms p99 420ms. streaming-stall rate down 78%. expected error bump from rejects ~0.6%.

cust-b-eng: thanks for the fast response — we see much better latency. we'll refactor our schema to use references instead of full descriptors.

alina: good. action items:
- devin: finalize ingress gate and publish guidance page (links in comms).
- kyle: land template-hydration short-ref patch and monitor for regressions.
- hema: upload traces + offending payload samples to incident board for RCA.
- matt: follow-up comms to affected customers + status update.

hema: collecting and saving traces now. tagging tokenizer hotspots and memory copy counts. will include top offending templates.

kyle: patch promoted to prod canary, no anomalies. scheduling rollback plan if any regression observed.

incident-bot: Incident 3599997777 status: mitigations deployed, monitoring. SEV2.

alina: closing live mitigation phase. will keep monitoring and proceed to a full postmortem focusing on: template expansion behavior, tokenizer CPU hotspots (single-threaded hotspots?), memory copy amplification during hydration, and ingress validation thresholds. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
